maddeler.e:
أتعايش (form VI)
# أَتَعَايَشُ (ʔataʕāyašu) /ʔa.ta.ʕaː.ja.ʃu/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of تَعَايَشَ (taʕāyaša)
# أَتَعَايَشَ (ʔataʕāyaša) /ʔa.ta.ʕaː.ja.ʃa/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of تَعَايَشَ (taʕāyaša)
# أَتَعَايَشْ (ʔataʕāyaš) /ʔa.ta.ʕaː.jaʃ/: first-person singular non-past active jussive of تَعَايَشَ (taʕāyaša)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
